english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something permitted by law, and it also commonly describes a move or syntax that is accepted as valid.
Use this as the all-purpose choice when something is permitted or recognised by law.
Use 合法 as the all-purpose choice when something complies with the law or legal requirements.
